name: DigitalOcean Functions

evidence.paas: 03: managed functions platform; DigitalOcean provisions and scales the execution infrastructure

line: Deploy managed functions that scale with requests.

free.text: 90,000 GiB-seconds per month, pooled across Functions

work.math: Standalone Functions is not a built-in way to host static sites.
Modeled at 150,000 GiB-seconds. This is the Functions cost after free usage.
Managed PostgreSQL is billed separately. The full hosting total is not confirmed.
